import sys

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    mod = 1000000007
    return pow(base, exp, mod)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    power = 1
    if k == 0:
        power = p - 1
    elif k == 1:
        power = p
    else:
        x = k
        while True:
            x = (x * k) % p
            power += 1
            if x == 1:
                break
        power = (p - 1) // power
    print(mod_pow(p, power))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
